t: Grounding the AI-Optimized Link Graph: Reality, Pseudomorphism, and the Cybernetic Dashboard
s: This article details the process of grounding an AI-optimized website link graph by integrating real-world Google Search Console data, transforming abstract digital structures into a 'cybernetic dashboard' that reflects actual performance and market potential.
sub: Integration of Google Search Console data
Bridging digital abstraction and tangible reality
Pipulate project architecture for site building
